acceptance: A reproducible table (bundle short id, run timestamp, worktree commit at run time, wheel version, evidence source) for all 58 bundles is written to CORPUS_NOTES, replacing the contradictory sentences; the command(s) used to build it are recorded.
Each wheel value is backed by primary evidence (commit pin, venv dist-info, or run log line); bundles without evidence are listed as unknown with the reason.
The 'recorded by the repository lock' sentence is corrected or removed so that the notes state one consistent account.
PR merged via make pr-open (oracle SHIP, no override) and make pr-arm; `uv run -- python results-data/validate_corpus.py` exits 0.
context: DECISION GATE: if more than a handful of bundles have no primary evidence, STOP and ask the owner whether to attest only the evidenced ones or none.
description:
results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md contradicts itself about the translator used by the 58 local rerun bundles ingested by PR #3678: one passage (~line 909) says all 58 ran on wheel 30.24.0.17; another (~lines 994-995) says 14 ran on 30.25.0.2; another (~line 1259) says the wheel 'is recorded by the repository lock, not by the bundles'. Before any sidecar attests a translator version, establish per bundle which wheel actually ran, from primary evidence.

EVIDENCE SOURCES (in order of strength): the uv.lock / benchbox/_vendor/sqlglot.json at the exact commit of the worktree each run used (run timestamps in the bundle vs the rerun branch history `git log` of chore/superseded-reruns-bundles and the adoption PRs #3587 (30.25.0.1), #3649 (30.25.0.2)); run logs under /tmp/sgrr*, ~/Developer/benchmark_runs logs; the venv used (e.g. /tmp/bbvenv-linux-sgrr for the container lane) and its installed benchbox_sqlglot dist-info if still present. If evidence is missing for a bundle, record 'unknown' for it: never guess.

GUARDRAILS: bundle JSON never modified; only CORPUS_NOTES text; every per-bundle wheel claim cites its evidence; no new runs.
